name: Prime or Not? Number Quiz
subtitle: Prime Pick · Math brain game
promotionalText: Prime or not? One tap decides. Take on today's Daily Challenge, share your result with friends, and beat your Time Attack best. Now in 10 languages!
description:
Is 91 prime? It sure looks like one, but 91 = 7 × 13.
Each question shows a single number. Tap PRIME or NOT PRIME, and that's all there is to it. It's easy to learn, quick to play, and every answer sharpens your number sense.

■ THREE WAYS TO PLAY
• Practice: Pick 5, 10 or 20 questions and take your time. There's no time limit, and every answer comes with a quick explanation like "51 = 3 × 17".
• Time Attack: Score as high as you can in 15, 30 or 60 seconds. A wrong answer costs you points and seconds.
• Daily Challenge: 10 new questions once a day, and everyone gets the same set. Keep your streak going and share your result with friends.

■ FOUR DIFFICULTY LEVELS
• Easy: 1–99
• Normal: 100–999
• Hard: 100–999 (no multiples of 2, 3 or 5)
• Expert: 1000–9999 (no multiples of 2, 3 or 5)

■ SCORES & RECORDS
• Every correct answer earns points. Harder levels, longer combos and faster answers earn more.
• The results screen shows your accuracy, max combo and a score breakdown. Look back at the numbers you missed, with their prime factorization.
• Your top 10 Time Attack scores are saved for each time limit and difficulty.

■ ALSO
• Haptics, sound effects and animations for every right and wrong answer
• Light, Dark or System theme
• Available in 10 languages: English, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Korean, Spanish, French, German, Italian and Portuguese (Brazil)

This app contains ads.

whatsNew.text:
• Prime Pick has a new name: “Prime or Not?” It's the same app, and your records and streaks carry over.
• Now in 10 languages: English, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Korean, Spanish, French, German, Italian and Portuguese (Brazil).
• Share your Daily Challenge result as an emoji grid and an image card. The day's numbers stay hidden, so there are no spoilers for your friends.
